rules.effective_date_basis: This chapter shall continue in full force and effect from October 19, 1988.
rules.title: Newark rent control and annual increase limitations
rules.requirement: For covered Newark dwellings, rent is controlled at the applicable rent level and landlords may not institute rent increases except as allowed by the chapter. The Rent Control Board may not grant increases exceeding 25% in any one year for any tenant, and certain new construction, vacant-property, and rehabilitation exemptions or increases may apply.
rules.key_value: No increases except as provided; Board may not grant increases over 25% in any one year; substantially rehabilitated vacant apartment unit increase capped at 10% if spending equals at least 12 months of actual monthly rent

coverage.other_unresolvable: Newly constructed multiple dwellings may be exempt for the lesser of the initial mortgage amortization period or 30 years after completion; vacant dwellings may receive a five-year exemption if vacancy and rehabilitation-cost conditions are met; substantially reconstructed or rehabilitated dwellings may have unrestricted initial rent if Board determinations are made.
coverage.summary: Applies to dwellings to which Newark’s Rent Control chapter is applicable, subject to stated exemptions for new construction, qualifying vacant properties, and substantial rehabilitation.

rules.exemptions: Newly constructed multiple dwellings are exempt from periodic or regular base-rent increase limits for a period not exceeding the initial mortgage amortization period or 30 years after completion, whichever is less. Dwellings vacant for at least 18 months, or already vacant on the effective date of § 19:2-18.2, may be exempt for five years if rehabilitation or reconstruction costs during a twelve-month period exceed 50% of fair market value and code/CO requirements are met. Substantially reconstructed or rehabilitated dwellings may set unrestricted initial rent if the Board makes the required determinations.
rules.penalty: Violation of the chapter or misrepresentation before the Rent Control Board is punishable by a fine of not less than $100 and not more than $2,000, imprisonment for not more than 90 days, or both; the Municipal Court may also impose a monetary penalty not exceeding $2,000 for each violation.
rules.interaction: The chapter states that rent increases are barred except as provided in the Newark Rent Control chapter as amended and supplemented, and it incorporates state-law consequences for certain unlawful entries related to forced vacancy and rehabilitation.
rules.quoted_span: All rent for the rental of housing space and services in dwellings to which this chapter is applicable are hereby controlled at the rent level received by the landlord, as of the first date that this chapter was adopted, on September 4, 1985, and no rental increases shall hereafter be instituted, except as provided in this chapter as amended and supplemented.
